desc: Newspaper Advertisement regarding the 32nd Annual General Meeting of the Company to be held on Wednesday, September 30, 2026.

Pursuant to Regulation 42 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform you that the 32nd Annual General Meeting of the Company is scheduled to be held on Wednesday, September 30, 2026 at 11:00 A.M (IST) through Video Conferencing ("VC") /Other Audio-Visual Means ("OVAM").
The intimation of Book Closure and Record date is as enclosed.
